Come study with us
Study our undergraduate or postgraduate courses and learn from leading professionals and researchers in fields including chemical, environmental, energy, food and water engineering and explore the emerging fields of nanotechnology and molecular biology, including leading researchers from the Net Zero Institute and the Sydney Nano Institute.

Transforming industries and solving global challenges
With a unique collective of leading multi-disciplinary scholars, we are the world's first entity that offers a full suite of research and educational offerings in projects.
Our scholarship contributes to the knowledge and practice for projects which shape sustainable, resilient, and just societies; projects for human-centred digital and data-driven transformations; organising and leading complex engineering, technological and innovation projects
